raw_response: {"diagnosis": "From batch 3 onward the source delivers some transactions up to about 3 days after txn_ts. Batch 11 ingested 01-16 carries 01-13 transactions, and the profile shows txn_ids are unique, so these are not replays. The silver step's hard-coded 26-hour ingest-lag filter silently drops these valid late-arriving POSTED rows. Silver and every gold table are therefore undercounted.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.62, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
